args.text:
The batch has 8 runs, and all 8 were accepted. 1 is flagged and 7 are cleared.

Flagged:
- r03 (check_failed_but_accepted): the closure check failed. It measured 2.769 px/h against a 1.0 px/h threshold but was still marked as passed. The profile shape is also different from the rest of the batch. The largest flank difference is at 21 µm, against 84 µm for the batch (z -6.38). The growth zone is 695 µm, against 684 µm (z 2.26). This means the tip motion from the midline and stage log does not match the tip motion from the tracked kinematics.

Cleared:
- r01, r02, r07, r08: every summary is close to the batch (|z| ≤ 0.67) and every check that was run passed. r01 used the width-free ratio, so its plane-sections check was not run.
- r04, r05, r06: the flank difference has the opposite sign (-0.91 and -0.46 %/h). Plane sections passed for all three, so the flank difference matches the curvature rate, which means these roots are bending the other way. The REGR peak position and the flank-difference position match the batch. The growth zone is the same as the batch or about 1.5% shorter.

What the flagged run shows: only r03 is flagged. It was reported with the width-free ratio, so plane sections was not run and closure was the only check that compared tip motion with the tracked kinematics. Closure failed while marked as passed, and the run was still accepted.
